recommendation: Keep the audit commit. If variant identifier cardinality needs future correction, make the change in HL7/genomics-reporting or another owning external artifact rather than reviving retired core Observation-genetics content.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to make Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange.Id support multiple identifiers from systems such as dbSNP and ClinVar. The accepted resolution said this was already handled in the Genomics Reporting IG variation-code component with 0..* codings.
initial_application: Historical core source had a legacy Observation-genetics Variant.Id row with 0..1 CodeableConcept, and no FHIR-13833-specific core commit was found. Clinical Genomics minutes approved FHIR-13832, FHIR-13833, and FHIR-13835 together as already applied to the Genomics Reporting IG but not to Observation-genetics in FHIR Core; later core history pointed genomics guidance to the IG and removed outdated clinical genomics artifacts.
additional_context: Current FHIR core still builds Observation but has no active Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange or Observation-genetics variant profile. Core narrative directs implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG for structured genetic results. The FHIR Extension Pack has a retired/deprecated legacy observation-geneticsVariant extension that says it is replaced by the Genomics Reporting Guide. The current Genomics Reporting IG Variant profile has Observation.component:variation-code at 0..* with a CodeableConcept value.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Reintroducing or editing Observation-geneticsDNAVariantChange.Id in core would be outside current build scope and contrary to the accepted external-IG disposition.
